text:
Alex T.: Quick random Q — if you could name a constellation, what would you call it and why?
Maria P.: 'The Overflowing Coffee' — a cluster that only appears at 3pm. ☕️
Samir: The Debugger — looks like a bug icon, naturally blamed for outages. :bug:
Jen: 'Patchnotes' — you'd only see it after a patch, and it's always one star short.
Devon: 'Lag' — faint, only visible when you squint; comes with a 200ms delay :laughing:
Zoe: 'Snack Ring' — shaped like a donut, mandatory to orbit pizza places. 🍩
Alex T.: Love these. Bonus: if you had to draw it on a t-shirt, what's the caption?
Maria P.: 'Lost in the Milky Stack' 😅
Samir: 'PUT /stars -> 404' (classic)
Jen: 'constellation.exe has stopped working' — big hit for dev merch
Devon: Also, can we get a physical constellation map of our office? :eyes:
Zoe: Ooh yes. Office map with constellations marking snack locations.
Giphy (bot): :sparkles::stars: [gif: twinkling stars]
Alex T.: Thanks team, this is excellent. I'll sketch a few and maybe drop in #swag later :art:
Maria P.: Can't wait. :thumbsup:
